title: Jeera Rice
description: Basmati rice tempered with cumin seeds and whole spices — a simple, fragrant side that pairs with almost any dal or curry.

ingredients.name: Ghee
ingredients.notes: or oil, for a vegan version

steps: Rinse the basmati rice under cold water until it runs mostly clear, then soak for 15-20 minutes and drain.
Heat the ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds, bay leaf, cinnamon and cardamom, and let them sizzle for 30-40 seconds until fragrant.
Add the drained rice and stir gently for 1-2 minutes to coat it in the tempered ghee.
Add the water and salt, bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer for 12-15 minutes without lifting the lid.
Turn off the heat and let the rice rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff gently with a fork and garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
